notes:
NEW REELM LOGO. The app icon, the TV banner and the startup screen all use the new gold vinyl logo.

UP NEXT IN CONTINUE WATCHING. When you finish an episode, its Continue Watching tile moves on to the next episode you have not watched yet, marked Up next. Finished movies now leave the row by themselves.

REWATCHING KEEPS WATCHED. Playing an episode you already watched again no longer turns it back into Watching. It stays marked Watched and shows how far into the rewatch you are.

A DEAD STREAM LEAVES NOTHING BEHIND. If a stream never starts playing, the title no longer shows up in Continue Watching because of it.
